review.official:
A graduate of the
Victorian
National University who majored in
Originium
Research, Ceylon now works as an assistant researcher to Dr.
Kal'tsit
on her indoor research work.
She has a precocious level of master in water arts and can provide reliable treatment to allies on the battlefield.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Somatic Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 0%
Although for occupational reasons, the patient must come into extended contact with Originium, the operator has taken the appropriate steps to protect herself. As a result, she shows no sign of infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
The numbers are on the high side of normal, but Originium researchers do not yet believe there is anything to be concerned about.

She is a somewhat arrogant and spoiled young lady.
The reason why I say 'young lady' instead of 'researcher' is because she gives such a strong impression of a spoiled noble lady that any time she is mentioned, they will say 'Ah! That Lady!' even if they know the content of her work.
Of course, even though they'll ridicule her as 'the Lady,' there isn't anybody who actually dislikes her. This is because most of the time, she is right, and if she is wrong, she is not stingy with her apologies.

Ceylon's hometown, Siesta, is a rare independent city.
Its rareness lies not just in the fact that it's a non-nomadic city, but also that it's an independent city, and even more so in that it is currently in a state of rapid development.
In truth, on Terra, even though there are many long-established nations, nations are not a widespread concept. Independent city-states, however, are.
It should be said that in the context of the present day, the social collectives referred to by 'nation' were city-states in the past. The predecessors of several nations were independent cities gathered together. Additionally, even today, some nomadic cities that nominally belong to certain nations still to varying degrees retain the customs and traditions of the city as opposed to those of the nation.
However, it must be conceded that the concept of an independent city is falling by the wayside, although the old-fashioned and elderly might refuse to admit it. That is because the concept of a nation is more powerful.
Now, even though there is still a considerable number of independent cities on Terra, their leaders have already recognized that independent cities are no match for nations. In recent years, there have been many such independent cities that have surrendered to neighboring nations.
However, Siesta's special characteristics may be able to take them in a new direction.

In order to better facilitate understanding, Ceylon did not mention her specific area of study when introducing herself. In fact, the discipline of Originium Research has a large number of sub-categories, both in the applied area of the doctrine as well as the theoretical. Ceylon specializes in researching the history of applied development of Originium. 
Before the modern academics managed to specialize the research, many precious historical materials on Originium were not well preserved. In fact, collecting clues from past historical data to infer the paths of development of the various Originium schools was also an important part of modern Originium research.
Although today, with the development of science and technology, the study of historical materials has gradually become less concerned with the development of theory and more the verification of it. Of course, the importance of recording history itself is self-evident for the meaning of a civilization.
Naturally, although Ceylon has only just graduated from university, her intellectual reserves and enthusiasm for the study of Originium is breath-taking, and one can clearly see how much effort Ceylon put into her studies. For Rhodes Island, the addition of such an outstanding talent is a most unexpected surprise.

The reason why Schwarz's presence is not mentioned in Ceylon's file is the same reason Ceylon was not mentioned in Schwarz's.
The reason is very simple, and that's because it's simply not necessary. Words cannot be used to sufficiently describe the depth of feeling they have for one another.
However, one point that may be worth recording is that while they regard one another as the most important thing in each other's lives, their worlds are not merely limited to one another.
Ceylon still eats with other researchers, works with them, and can argue theory until the wee hours of the morning. Schwarz can independently carry out her tasks as well as hit the taverns with other mercenary operators and engage in hand-to-hand combat with them in the practice area.
They both have their own independent lives, and after joining Rhodes Island, they expanded their horizons even more. We can intuit that they will become more accustomed to this life while still remaining as important to one another as they've always been.
This could be described as a 'profound mutual affection,' with emphasis put on 'profound.'

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Doctor, I'll be writing reports or reading nearby, just call when you need me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I believe you reap what you sow, and have always followed that principle.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Wow, I never imagined Oripathy would have such a trait! This requires immediate testing… Um, Doctor, I'm sorry, but I need to leave now. Hmm, I wonder if there's a suitable subject on base…

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The day is not complete without tea. Would you like a cup too, Doctor? I have the finest Victorian leaves here.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I've been with Schwarz since childhood. I know everything about her, including her past from before we met. Oh, but I won't give that up so easily, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: If I could find a cure for Schwarz, wouldn't that mean I could cure other Infected too...? Relax, Doctor, I'm not that selfish. But please also know that Schwarz is dearest to my heart.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Originium research is still a vastly unexplored territory, Doctor. But I just want to find a cure for Schwarz, which is why I longed to join Rhodes Island since I first heard of it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Do you know, Doctor, that I despise those who discriminate against Schwarz on account of her infection alone? But here, she is accepted, and I can learn more about medicine. Coming to Rhodes Island was truly the right decision.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: No matter how good a leader is, there's still a chance to be blinded by selfish interest, so you must watch out for that, Doctor. Hehe, but still, you don't need to worry that much. As long as I'm around, I'll put you back on the right path anytime you stray.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Falling asleep in a sitting position is a nasty habit, Doctor. Let me get you a blanket, at least.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Ceylon, graduate of Victoria National University, with a major in Originium research. I start my internship at Rhodes Island today, with Dr. Kal'tsit's approval. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: An excellent application of Originium. Rhodes Island sure lives up to its reputation.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: So I'm officially recognized by Rhodes Island? Thank you, Doctor, I'll work even harder.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Rhodes Island does boast terrific Originium research. If I keep working here, I'm sure I will cure Schwarz one day. Doctor, please help me on this path.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: A mission? A perfect opportunity to test my Originium Arts.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Relax, I'm a confident commander.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I wonder if we'll find rare materials along the way?

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Don't panic, handle it with composure.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Where are the wounded?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Leave the support work to me.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: If you're wounded, don't move.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You're all free to focus on the mission.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Concentrate on the enemy ahead!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: This one should be better for the present situation.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew... I feel like I just wrapped up a difficult experiment. It's tiring, but very fulfilling too.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: The enemy should be gone now...  Alright then, I'm going to look around the perimeter.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: If I were as good as Schwarz, they wouldn't have gotten away…

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't just stand there, Doctor, give me a hand with the wounded!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Hm, maybe I could talk to the other doctors on base.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Wait, my hair is getting messed up!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Did the Doctor fall asleep in that chair again?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Yes, I'll go and chat with my Medical Department colleagues for a while, and then meet up with Schwarz later on. New Year's could never be more interesting at home than at Rhodes Island, and I've sent my father a card in any case.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How are you, Doctor? Care for some tea with me?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's your birthday present, Doctor. I know what it's like. You bury yourself in books or research, and you just can't help forgetting to take breaks. But with a tea set this beautiful by your side, I'm sure you'll be more minded to pause and brew a cup... hm? Oh, don't worry, it wasn't... terribly expensive.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I might have gained new knowledge from my predecessors' writings at university. However, only after sailing such a long course with Rhodes Island, have I truly touched on the breadth of this land, and gained all kinds of experience the books never held. Ah, and on top of that, Schwarz is doing wonderfully here. Thank you all for looking after her.
